label: Figure 1
source_caption: BlueFin is a challenging benchmark for characterizing LLM spreadsheet generation.
caption: Compare the bottom panels. Synthesis and manipulation are graded by rubric items of different kinds: is the formula right, is the value within ±2%, does the output recompute after an input change. Interrogation is graded by matching an answer. The perturbation items ("If SOFR 2.5% → 3.5%, does…") are the ones the results will show models fail most.
